name: Vertical blur over whole rows

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: wasm/web with headed Playwright and WebGPU enabled
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Vertical blur over whole rows Hypothesis

The vertical pass gathered each column into a line (a cache miss a pixel), blurred it and scattered it back. Running the same box (and small Gaussian) sums down every column at once, a row of values at a time, does the same float operations per value in the same order over contiguous memory.\n\n**Tested mechanism:** row-wise vertical pass. **Allowed:** render `blur`, new `blur_columns`/`box_rows`/`gaussian_rows`. **Forbidden:** horizontal pass, blur math.
